title: Returned-Payment Fees on Small Returned Amounts - Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The returned-payment fee on a Credit Builder account is set by the returned amount of the account's most recent returned payment, measured against the plan's returned-payment fee and the plan's monthly payment.

## Rule

- When the returned amount is at least the plan's returned-payment fee but less than the plan's monthly payment, the fee is the small-payment percent (10.0 percent) of the returned amount, not more than the plan's returned-payment fee.
- When the returned amount is less than the plan's returned-payment fee, the fee is the returned amount itself.
- When the returned amount is the plan's monthly payment or more, the fee is the plan's returned-payment fee.

The returned amount is the amount on the return line of that returned payment. The fee set here is worked unrounded and is rounded to the cent only once, at the end of the fee's calculation.

| Plan | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Monthly payment (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Credit Builder 600 Plan | 10.00 | 54.42 |
| Credit Builder 1000 Plan | 10.00 | 90.69 |
| Credit Builder 1200 Plan | 10.00 | 58.61 |
| Credit Builder 1800 Plan | 10.00 | 87.91 |
| Credit Builder 2400 Plan | 10.00 | 117.16 |
| Credit Builder 3000 Plan | 10.00 | 104.72 |

| Returned amount | Fee |
|---|---|
| less than 10.00 | the returned amount itself |
| 10.00 up to, but not including, the plan's monthly payment | 10.0 percent of the returned amount, not more than 10.00 |
| the plan's monthly payment or more | 10.00 |

## Hypothetical returns on the Credit Builder 1000 Plan

| Returned amount | Fee before any other step |
|---|---|
| 6.00 | 6.00 |
| 10.00 | 1.00 |
| 45.00 | 4.50 |
| 90.69 | 10.00 |
